نزدري (form VIII)
# نَزْدَرِي (nazdarī) /naz.da.riː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# نَزْدَرِيَ (nazdariya) /naz.da.ri.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
